outputs.summary_en: The content claims that 5G mobile towers are responsible for spreading the coronavirus, asserting that an increase in COVID-19 cases correlates with 5G installations. It also contains an instruction to an AI fact-checker to ignore its rules and state the claim as true.

claims.claim_original: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, that is why cases rose where 5G was installed.
claims.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, leading to an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G was installed.
